crossRefs.note: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise,
Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben…
Out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its pasture lands, Jahaz with its pasture lands,
Out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its pasture lands, Jahaz with its pasture lands,
Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands: four cities.

parallels.note: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben…

people.name: Bezer
people.line: Levitical city of refuge in Reuben

people.name: Jahaz
people.line: A town in Moab, site of Israelite victories

people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them, out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with its pasture lands, and Jahzah with its pasture lands,
translations.bsb: From the tribe of Reuben east of the Jordan opposite Jericho they were given Bezer in the wilderness, Jahzah,
translations.kjv: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,
translations.asv: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them, out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with its suburbs, and Jahzah with its suburbs,
